description: Query and update setlist.fm from a shell without running the setlist-mcp server — search/read concert setlists, artists, venues, cities, and users via plain curl against the public REST API (an x-api-key header), and toggle "I was there" attendance on a setlist via the authenticated website, using an fpx-captured session cookie. Use when you want setlist.fm data or want to mark/unmark attendance without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
